points: Abishag the Shunammite is found and ministers to the king, but he does not know her. That means he did not have relations with her; she was there only to keep him warm.

note.label: 1 Kings 1: A King Exalts Himself and a King Is Anointed

points: Elisha calls Gehazi to call the Shunammite, and when she comes he tells her to take up her son. She falls at his feet, bows to the ground, takes up her son, and goes out. This is another act of the Most High through Elisha, restoring the child to life.

note.label: 2 Kings 4: The Widow's Oil and the Shunammite's Son
